articleTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting
imageHeadline: Can't Sit Cross-Legged? Your Hips Need These 4 Stretches
imageSubtext: Target the muscles that actually limit your range of motion
pinTitle: 4 Hip Stretches to Improve Cross-Legged Sitting | Evidence-Based Mobility
pinDescription: If sitting cross-legged feels uncomfortable or impossible, limited hip mobility is usually the culprit. Learn which muscles restrict your range of motion and the four stretches that target them effectively, plus how often to practice for real improvement.
